subject.title: fix(cli): bound --message-file reads for agent command

question: Should `openclaw agent --message-file` permanently cap input at 4 MiB while continuing to follow symlink chains?
rationale: The safety fix is valid, but the maximum size and symlink policy are public CLI behavior choices; current docs do not define them and the related PR proposes a different symlink policy.

options.title: Keep 4 MiB and symlinks
options.body: Retain this PR’s bounded, compatibility-preserving behavior and document the limit and symlink support before merge.

options.title: Adopt strict regular files
options.body: Coordinate with the broader file/stdin PR to reject symlinks and define all message-input validation through one stricter contract.

options.title: Choose another ceiling
options.body: Select a different maximum and align the implementation, tests, help, documentation, and real-behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Keep 4 MiB and symlinks
recommendation.body: Retain this PR’s bounded, compatibility-preserving behavior and document the limit and symlink support before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available merger and review signal for the existing message-file CLI contract.
